verdict.aLooksLike: a brown dog with a long striped tan snout, perked ears, a white facial band, and grey front paws
verdict.bLooksLike: a brown dog with floppy side ears, an angled white snout, a white chest patch, and matching brown paws
reasons: Model B's head and face read much more cleanly as a dog, with well-placed floppy ears and a compact, angled white muzzle instead of Model A's overly long, layered tan-and-white snout and distracting white facial stripe.

Model B uses a more coherent color scheme, giving all four paws matching brown bricks rather than Model A's mismatched grey front feet and brown back feet, and keeping the white markings focused on the muzzle and chest.
Model B's front shoulders and chest integrate smoothly into the torso, whereas Model A has awkward 2x2 brown blocks sticking out to the sides of the chest.
verdict.remainingGap: The horizontal white plate under the chin in Model B juts out to the sides with exposed studs, looking slightly unfinished from the front.
